name: Methadyl acetate
aliases: Acetylmethadol, Acetilmetadol, acetylmethadol, Acetylmethadolum, Betamethadol, betacetylmethadol, alphacetylmethadol, levomethadyl acetate
summary: Acetylmethadol, also known as methadyl acetate, is a synthetic opioid analgesic. It is a racemic mixture of alphacetylmethadol (α-acetylmethadol) and betacetylmethadol (β-acetylmethadol), which are in turn racemic mixtures of levacetylmethadol (LAAM; L-α-acetylmethadol) and D-α-acetylmethadol and L-β-acetylmethadol and D-β-acetylmethadol, respectively. Hence, acetylmethadol has four possible optical isomers.

uses.text: All of these isomers have been shown to partially or fully substitute for the discriminative stimulus effects of heroin in rats, and thus it can be inferred that, in addition to LAAM which is used clinically as such, they are all likely to be active opioid analgesics in humans.

pharmacology.en: It activates the mu opioid receptor, like methadone and morphine, and the body turns it into active breakdown products that carry much of its long-lasting effect.
pharmacology.zh: 它和美沙冬、嗎啡一樣活化 μ 型鴉片受體，身體會把它轉換成具活性的代謝物，這些代謝物承擔了它大部分的持久作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它和美沙冬、吗啡一样活化 μ 型鸦片受体，身体会把它转换成具活性的代谢物，这些代谢物承担了它大部分的持久作用。

sideEffects.en: It causes typical opioid effects such as drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and it leads to dependence. It can also cause a dangerous heart rhythm problem, which led to the withdrawal of LAAM.
sideEffects.zh: 它會引起嗜睡、噁心、便秘與呼吸減慢等典型鴉片類作用，並會導致依賴。它也可能造成危險的心律問題，這正是 LAAM 撤出市場的原因。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会引起嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸减慢等典型鸦片类作用，并会导致依赖。它也可能造成危险的心律问题，这正是 LAAM 撤出市场的原因。

fact.en: One of its forms, LAAM, was approved in the United States in 1993 to treat opioid dependence because it lasts longer than methadone, but it was later withdrawn after links to dangerous heart rhythm problems.
fact.zh: 它的其中一種形式 LAAM 因作用比美沙冬持久，在1993年獲美國核准用於治療鴉片類依賴，後來因與危險的心律問題有關而撤出市場。
fact.zhHans: 它的其中一种形式 LAAM 因作用比美沙冬持久，在1993年获美国核准用于治疗鸦片类依赖，后来因与危险的心律问题有关而撤出市场。
